00045 Text NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(Locations location, const char *filename) throw()
00046 {
00047  ugen_assert(filename != 0);
00048  
00049  switch(location)
00050  {
00051   case Bundle: {
00052    NSString *nsFilename = [[NSString alloc] initWithUTF8String: filename];
00053    NSString* nspath = [[NSBundle mainBundle] pathForResource:nsFilename ofType:nil];
00054    [nsFilename release];
00055    
00056    if(!nspath)
00057     return "";
00058    else
00059     return [nspath UTF8String];
00060    
00061   } break;
00062    
00063   case Documents: {
00064    NSArray *paths = NSSearchPathForDirectoriesInDomains(NSDocumentDirectory, NSUserDomainMask, YES);
00065    NSString *documentsDirectory = [paths objectAtIndex:0];
00066    if (!documentsDirectory) 
00067     return "";
00068    else
00069    {
00070     NSString *nsFilename = [[NSString alloc] initWithUTF8String: filename];
00071     NSString *appFile = [documentsDirectory stringByAppendingPathComponent:nsFilename];
00072     [nsFilename release];
00073     return [appFile UTF8String];
00074    }
00075    
00076   } break;
00077   
00078   case Temporary: {
00079 //   NSString *tmp = NSTemporaryDirectory();
00080 //   if(!tmp)
00081 //    return "";
00082 //   else
00083 //   {
00084 //    NSString *nsFilename = [[NSString alloc] initWithUTF8String: filename];
00085 //    NSString *appFile = [tmp stringByAppendingPathComponent:nsFilename];
00086 //    [nsFilename release];
00087 //    return [appFile UTF8String];
00088 //   }
00089    
00090    NSString *home = NSHomeDirectory();
00091    if(!home)
00092     return "";
00093    else
00094    {
00095     return Text([home UTF8String]) << Text("/tmp/") << Text(filename);
00096    }
00097    
00098   }
00099    
00100   default:
00101    return "";
00102  }
00103  
00104 }
